scripts.dev: bun run database && next dev && bun run database:down
scripts.build: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && next build --webpack
scripts.launch: bun run database && bun run build && bun run start
scripts.launch:test: scripts/with-test-database.sh sh -c 'bun run build && bun run start'
scripts.lint-format: bun run lint && bun run format
scripts.heroui: bunx --package npm@10 npm exec --package heroui-cli -- heroui
scripts.pre-commit: bun run test && bun run lint-format
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: scripts/with-test-database.sh sh -c 'export NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1; bun run build && start-server-and-test "bun run start" http://localhost:3000 "bunx playwright test"'
scripts.database:dev: bun run database && prisma migrate dev && bun run database:down
scripts.database:deploy: prisma migrate deploy && prisma db seed
scripts.database:test: sh -c 'docker compose -f compose-test.yml up --detach --wait && DATABASE_URL="postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:${TEST_DATABASE_PORT:-55433}/simple_tasks_test?schema=public" bun run database:create'
scripts.database:create: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && prisma db seed
scripts.database:studio: bun run database && bunx prisma studio && bun run database:down
